promises.quote: The Trust proposes to undertake some work to address the fact that low dose prophylactic anticoagulants in the form that Mr Jones received must be included in this medical assessment, and instructions given to nursing staff as to whether this medication should be continued or stopped. This likely to include redrafting part of the post falls sticker to this effect, and providing accompanying training to doctors about this change, and the reason for it.
